title: PERFORMANCE.md front matter
description: The front matter of a PERFORMANCE.md file, format version 1.0 (spec.md). `performance-md lint` checks this schema plus what a schema can't express: units by dimension, metrics each tool emits, unique metric and stat, and overrides of real targets.

version.description: The format version this file needs, as a quoted "major.minor" string.
version.errorMessage: must be a quoted "major.minor" string, like "1.0"

name.description: Defaults to the folder name. Unique across a repository: results are keyed by it.

measure.description: How the surface is measured; a list holds one entry per tool.

later.description: Reserved for a later version of the format.
later.errorMessage: not supported yet: reserved for a later version of the format

quantity.description: A number, an optional space and a unit: B, KB, MB (1 KB = 1024 B), ms, s, %, or none.
quantity.errorMessage: {value} is not a quantity: a number, an optional space and a unit, like 175 KB, 2.5 s, 2% or 0.1

origin.errorMessage: {value} is not an origin: a scheme and host with no path, like https://example.com

target.errorMessage: {value} is not a target: targets are paths starting with /, like /pricing

artifact.description: What the surface ships, read without running it.

type.errorMessage: {value} is not an artifact type; version 1.0 defines static-site

dist.description: The built site, relative to this file's folder.

hashed_assets.description: Glob of content-hashed files, used to find changed pages. Default none.

fonts.description: Count a @font-face only if the page uses characters in its range (default), or all of them.

overrides.description: Per target: budgets and rules keys that replace the file's.

static-site-budgets.description: Size limits applied to every page. A budget that isn't written isn't checked.

static-site-rules.description: Requirements without a size, applied to every page. A rule that isn't written isn't checked.

image_formats.description: Allowed image formats, by file extension.

items.errorMessage: {value} is not a format: write a file extension in lower case, like webp

image_dimensions.description: true: every has width and height.

origins.description: Where resources may load from: self and any other origins listed.

items.errorMessage: {value} is not self or an origin like https://cdn.example.com

measure.description: How the surface is measured, and the limits on what's measured.

tool.errorMessage: {value} is not a tool; version 1.0 defines lighthouse

noise.description: How noisy the measurement is, as a share of the base value. Default 0%.

overrides.description: Per target: metrics entries, merged over the file's by metric and stat.

metric.description: One statistic of one metric, with a limit, a delta or both.

stat.errorMessage: {value} is not a stat: median, mean, min, max, worst or p<N>, like p95

limit.description: The statistic must not be worse than this.

delta.description: How much worse than the base still counts as on par.
